subject: Re: Annual prepay structure and payment-term exception request
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@sps-tech.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rodrigo Santos <cfo@sps-tech.com>, procurement@sps-tech.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay + payment terms question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency benchmarks. Procurement asked me to follow up on two things before we proceed to SOW:

1) SPS wants to prepay for an annual commitment but needs to align cash flow across Q3/Q4. Are you able to support a split prepay (partial upfront, remainder billed on milestones over the year)?
2) Second, finance prefers Net60 on invoices. Would Redwood consider Net60 for milestone invoices if we provide an upfront deposit?

We want to avoid long legal redlines but need clarity so we can present to Rodrigo (CFO). Can you send a suggested payment schedule and note any pricing impact?

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of Procurement
SPS Tech

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@sps-tech.com>
Cc: Rodrigo Santos <cfo@sps-tech.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay + payment terms question

Hi Maria — really appreciate the straightforward ask.

High-level proposal (flexible to tweak):
- Term: 12 months annual commitment (start date on SOW signature)
- Payment: 50% upfront at signature, 50% in two equal milestone invoices (Month 4 and Month 8)
- Payment terms: Upfront deposit due on signature (immediate). Milestone invoices: Net60 from invoice date.
- Commercial sweetener: 6% term discount off list for the annual prepay/commit. If SPS agrees to a 24-month ramp (tiered committed capacity with 10% ARR increase year 2), we can move to 8% discount.
- Contingency: Default fallback to Net30 for any overdue milestone invoice after 45 days; Redwood requires a short SLA credit if milestone is delayed beyond payment runway.

Attachments: I attached a draft SOW showing the milestone schedule and a pricing matrix with the 6% discount baked in.

Next steps: If that structure sounds workable, I can kick off a short approval path with finance for the Net60 exception and route the SOW to legal for a limited-scope amendment (payment terms + milestone amounts).

Would you be available for a 20-min call Thursday to finalize?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: legal-team@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Annual prepay + payment terms question — approval request (DEAL-2026-0793)

Rishi / Connor — forwarding SPS request and my proposed 50/50 split with Net60 on milestone invoices. Key points:
- They want Net60 for milestone invoices if we accept a 50% upfront deposit.
- I proposed a 6% term discount for the 12-month prepay; we could flex to 8% for a 24-month ramp.
- Need finance sign-off on accepting Net60 on part of the contract and confirmation if we require additional protections (escrow, bank guarantee, or milestone holdback).

Can you confirm (1) whether finance can approve Net60 with 50% upfront, and (2) whether Revenue Ops needs a special billing code or recognition treatment for partial prepay? If you approve, please advise on any contract language Legal should add.

Thanks — hoping to keep this in the quarter.
Marissa

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: legal-team@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Annual prepay + payment terms question — approval request (DEAL-2026-0793)

Thanks Marissa — 50% upfront + Net60 on milestone invoices is acceptable at a commercial level for this enterprise profile, assuming Finance and Legal add guardrails. My asks:
- Legal: add a clause that milestone invoices are contingent on delivery acceptance (simple acceptance checklist) and a late-interest provision (1.5%/month after Net60).
- Finance: prefer Net45 but ok to approve Net60 for two milestone invoices only if we require either (a) a 10% irrevocable standby letter of credit, or (b) 50% escrow on the upfront until Month 6. Which is operationally easier?
- RevOps: flag on revenue recognition — split between upfront deferred revenue and milestone-recognized revenue.

If Finance confirms operational route, we can offer the 6% discount and request procurement to sign quickly.

-rishi
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: revenue-ops@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 14:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Annual prepay + payment terms question — approval request (DEAL-2026-0793)

Marissa / Rishi — Finance can approve the Net60 exception for the two milestone invoices under these conditions:
1) 50% of total ACV collected as nonrefundable deposit at signature (we can mark 50% as upfront revenue deferred to start-of-service),
2) Redwood receives either an irrevocable payment guarantee (standby LC) for 10% of total contract value or the client puts the 50% deposit into an escrow account managed by a named custodian; escrow preferred operationally.
3) Include a clause that milestones are tied to measurable delivery checkpoints (we will reference the SOW appendix A).

Action items for deal desk:
- Add billing code: RWD-PREPAY-50
- Revenue Ops: set up product/ARR allocation; we will split recognition per milestone acceptance.

I attached a pricing matrix showing ARR recognition scenarios and the billing code reference. If Procurement is comfortable with escrow, we can proceed to DocuSign.

Connor O'Brien
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@sps-tech.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rodrigo Santos <cfo@sps-tech.com>, procurement@sps-tech.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay + payment terms question

Marissa — thanks for the quick work and the clear options. Rodrigo reviewed Finance's conditions today and SPS is prepared to accept:
- 50% nonrefundable deposit at signature (escrow with FirstNational Custody)
- Remaining 50% billed in two milestone invoices (Month 4, Month 8) with Net60 on those milestone invoices
- Acceptance criteria: use the SOW appendix you referenced (we agree to the simple acceptance checklist)
- Agreed commercial: 6% term discount for the 12-month annual commitment

Please route the final SOW and DocuSign link to procurement; procurement will sign once escrow instructions and the DocuSign envelope reflect the agreed payment structure.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to getting started.

Regards,
Maria Lopez
Head of Procurement, SPS Tech
procurement@sps-tech.com
+1 (617) 555-0146
